title: flindersia collina
intro: Flindersia collina, commonly known as the White Beangle, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae, native to Australia. This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine and is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Flindersia collina include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
